issue.body:
## Feature Request

#### Describe the problem you need a feature to resolve.

#31 removed the generation of the main class because the latest versions of the Quarkus extension don't require it. However, in the process of testing I found an issue with Quarkus: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/19655. An easy fix would be to still create an empty `src/main/java` directory.

#### Describe the solution you'd like.

`operator-sdk init` should generate an empty `src/main/java` directory. Not sure how to do it with the plugin.
